shared_elements: low relief carving of figures facing the same direction
registers or panels of writing signs
procession or grouping of multiple attendant figures
justification: Both depict human figures rendered in profile relief with raised hands and are accompanied by dense script signs, but these are near-universal conventions rather than a shared scheme. A shows only bearded heads and torsos of figures in tall headgear with elaborately curled hair, while B shows a full ritual scene with a rayed disc whose rays end in hands, an offering table, and slender elongated worshippers — no distinctive motif is shared.
